verdict.rationale: Lithic supports issuing virtual cards with fine-grained authorization rules (MCC, country, velocity, spend limits) scoped to program/account/card level, and its own blog demonstrates creating a card for an AI agent with rules restricting its spend (lithic-docs-11, lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-13, lithic-docs-17, lithic-docs-12). This effectively delivers 'scoped credentials for an agent' via cards+rules rather than classic API-key permission scoping. Missing for 10: no documentation of least-privilege API key/token scoping for the Lithic API itself (e.g., role-based API keys), and no independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor materials.
